description: Action Result layer. Slot-level resolution order, defense precedence, randomness bounds, status transitions. Values are initial candidates, not balanced.

resolution.note: Every slot resolves from a snapshot taken at slot start. Actions landing within the simultaneity tolerance share that snapshot and apply together.

sub_beat.note: Impact position inside a slot, expressed as a fraction. Priority is an outcome of timing, not a separate rule. The 8-slot structure is unchanged.
sub_beat.note_simultaneity: Impacts within this tolerance resolve from the same snapshot and apply together, so a double knockout stays reachable.
sub_beat.note_evasion: Evasion Capability tightens alignment and widens the active window. Execution Speed is deliberately NOT applied to evasion: agility already feeds both derived values, and adding it again would double count (see docs/design/24_base_to_derived_mapping.md section 4).

first_strike.note: A strictly earlier impact is applied first. It weakens the later one rather than erasing it.

turn_carryover.note: Combo (turn) boundaries are continuous action, unlike round boundaries. State and short-lived effects carry across. Round boundary rules in docs/design/23_round_structure_and_judging.md take precedence where the two coincide.
turn_carryover.note_precedence: When a turn boundary is also a round boundary, the round rules apply and counter_window, feint_opening and recovery_window expire while gap resets.

randomness.note: Randomness creates variation, not causation. It never decides hit/miss, block, evade, or the winner. It only perturbs magnitude within a narrow band.

defense_precedence.note: Evaluated in order. The first matching defense resolves the exchange; later ones are not consulted.

evasion.note: Evasion is decided by trajectory matching and timing overlap, never by a roll. A mistimed or mismatched evasion is struck in a compromised posture.

guard.note: Blocking costs less stamina than the attack it absorbs, so blocking wins the exchange economically. Unprotected targets bypass guard entirely.

context_modifiers.note: read_confidence_defense_bonus tightens the defender's timing tolerance; pattern_break undoes it. Both are bounded so reading is an edge, never certainty.

status.note: No whole-body HP. Transitions come from instantaneous impact measured against effective_durability plus accumulated damage on the struck part.
status.note_counts: Knockdown counts are tracked per round and per fight; see docs/design/23_round_structure_and_judging.md.

judge_metrics.note: Accumulated per slot, aggregated per round by the Universal Judging Core.
